objective: Deliver a Chinese local learning product connected to the arbitrary-subject backend and selected DeepSeek provider. Real model validation occurs after coding; UI cannot pretend model knowledge is verified truth.
requirements: Extend createBackendServer to serve EXACT fixed assets GET/=public/assistant.html, /assistant.js, /assistant.css and /styles.css (existing stylesheet can be reused). No arbitrary-file serving/path resolution from user input. Same-origin /api/v1/... requests, keep strict Host/Origin/no CORS. CSP default-src self; connect-src self; script/style/font self; base-uri none; frame-ancestors none; form-action self; no inline script/CDN/external font. Preserve original public/index.html,app.js,styles.css and original src/server.mjs,learning.mjs,cli.mjs/tests/contracts byte-for-byte. Old demo remains available through npm run start:legacy. Change npm start to node src/backend-server.mjs; keep start:backend and npm test. No installs/frameworks.

Add LearningBackend.listAnswers(planId) and GET/api/v1/plans/:id/answers as read-only view of already persisted answer records, validating plan exists. No change to store schema, write authority, validator, AI_GENERATED_UNVERIFIED/mastery rules. No new authentication/permission/control modules.

High-quality Chinese warm-white/teal learning workspace consistent with prior visual style. Sidebar brand 知微 plus 我的学习目标 list (persisted GET/goals) and 新建目标. Main hero: 把陌生的领域，变成可走的路. Readiness badge comes from /api/v1/model-info; configured means 已配置 not false live health. Sidebar dynamic path and selected goal; main input form, underlying logic and core questions, concepts/dependencies, actionable ordered path, misconceptions; right sources/history panel. Responsive 390px and desktop, readable spacing, keyboard labels/focus/aria/status. No giant blank space or horizontally overflowing cards. No fixed JavaScript learning content in new UI.

Goal form accessible IDs: goal-form, subject, objective, level, weekly-hours, generate-plan. Accept arbitrary subject, concrete objective, level BEGINNER/INTERMEDIATE/ADVANCED, hours0.5..80. Examples 微积分/水彩绘画/电路分析 fill fields ONLY, never call model automatically. Submit creates new goal then explicitly POST/goal/:id/plans sourceIds[]; save created goal even if model fails. When goal selected load its actual plans, latest by revision and activities/answers; do not create goal/plan on page load. Existing goal may regenerate via explicit 生成新版本; new identity, no old snapshot overwrite. Provide version selection id plan-version for historical snapshots. Never restore a different goal through a stale request race.

One user action -> one generation/ask at most. Disable duplicate submits and navigation/selection/new-goal during active mutations. Show honest elapsed/loading status, not fabricated percent. Client fetch deadline135000ms, backend90-second DeepSeek/125-second job/130-second HTTP unchanged. NO automatic retries, live model calls on load, double charging or silently falling back. For failed/uncertain POST show recover action 检查已保存结果 that GETs plans/history BEFORE another explicit retry; do not claim failed request implies no saved plan. HTTP errors translated to understandable Chinese; do not expose provider body/stack/key. Missing model disables generation and explains configuration. Cached/stored snapshots readable without model.

Render every model/source/user string with textContent/createElement, never innerHTML/outerHTML/insertAdjacentHTML/eval/newFunction/markdown-to-HTML. No dangerous link: source URLs passed through HTTPS validation before assigning; rel noopener noreferrer targetblank. Show plan subject/objective/level, model, revision, estimated total hours/weeks as estimates, underlyingLogic/coreQuestions/concepts explanation whyItMatters prerequisites, all steps activity/deliverable/check, misconceptions/limitations and citations. Distinguish MODEL_ONLY = 模型生成，尚未联网核查; PINNED_SOURCES = 已绑定资料，引用未独立核验; TEST provider clearly test-only. No mastery percent or correct/accepted badges from model output.

Step selection id step-select; selected concrete step shows activity/deliverable/check. Buttons mark-exposure and activity-form with activity-note, assisted, save-activity -> recorded EXPOSURE or PRACTICE. Display counts/history and explicitly 活动记录不代表掌握; never invent grading. Q&A ask-form/question/ask-submit invokes POST/plans/:id/ask with real question, displays advisory answer+limits/source citations; reload restores GET/answers. Keep last answer visible after success; disable while busy. No user API-key fields.

Source panel optional add-source-form: source-title/source-url/source-text/add-source; POST/goals/:id/sources. Only original pasted text and HTTPS metadata, no URL fetch; avoid keys. Existing plan immutable: adding source says generate NEW version to use it; do not relabel existing plan grounding. Display selected plan sourceManifest refs alongside their pinned record. Optional search form search-query/search-button uses existing search API only if searchConfigured; otherwise disabled with 未配置联网搜索，当前使用模型知识和提供的资料. No claim internet verified. Display histories and source/provenance honestly.

Tests/assistant-workspace.test.mjs: genuine local HTTP with explicitly TEST provider, root/assets MIME/CSP, no arbitrary paths/secret served, create goal->plan->activity->ask->answers->read/reopen, unsafe Host/Origin and original lesson compatibility retained. Tests no real network/API/keys/subprocess; tempSQLite inside project removed. Update README and new DEEPSEEK_WORKSPACE.md for new main browser entry; preserve earlier immutable contracts/history. All product code via this dispatched Runtime, no pCOS/governance/git changes. Return JSON{summary,files,tests}. Real browser tests/credential launch done separately by trusted host after output binding/verification.
